# TOTL (Top of the League)

> TOTL, short for Top of the League, is a free-to-download Premier League prediction game. Each Gameweek players predict a Home Win, Draw or Away Win for every match, score a point for each correct prediction, and compete with friends in private mini-leagues and on public leaderboards. It is available on the web at playtotl.com, on iPhone (App Store) and on Android (Google Play).

TOTL is also written "TotL" or "Totl". The iPhone app is listed as "Totl - Top of the League" and the Android app as "TotL". The official website is https://playtotl.com/ and the official contact is hello@playtotl.com.

## Download TOTL

TOTL is available on three platforms. These are the only official links:

- [Play on the web](https://playtotl.com/): browser version at playtotl.com
- [Download for iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6754661450): App Store, "Totl - Top of the League" (App ID 6754661450, iPhone, iOS 15.1 or later)
- [Download for Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.despia.totlnative): Google Play, "TotL" (package com.despia.totlnative)

Both apps are free to download. The App Store and Google Play listings show in-app purchases: some branded leaderboards are unlocked with a one-off season access purchase.

## How the game works

- Before each Premier League Gameweek, players predict every match as a Home Win, Draw or Away Win.
- Predictions lock when the first match of the Gameweek kicks off.
- Each correct prediction scores 1 point. Points add up to a player's Overall Correct Predictions (OCP) for the season.
- Players can join at any point in the season and still compete, because the monthly leaderboard starts from zero each calendar month.

## Leaderboards

- **Global (All v All) leaderboard**: every TOTL player ranked against everyone else, with an Overall table for the season and a Gameweek table for the current week.
- **Monthly leaderboard**: a fresh race each calendar month using the same scoring (1 point per correct prediction across that month's Gameweeks). Anyone who submits predictions in a Gameweek that month is included. When the month's last Gameweek finishes, the player with the most points wins the month; ties share first place. Monthly wins and Gameweek wins are recorded as trophies.

## Mini-leagues

- Players create a private mini-league and invite friends with a league code (2 to 8 players).
- Each Gameweek is head-to-head: the player with the most correct predictions wins the week. League points are 3 for a win, 1 for a draw and 0 for a loss.
- In mini-leagues with 3 or more players, being the only person to correctly predict a fixture earns a "Unicorn". Unicorns break ties for the week; if players are still level, the week is a draw.
- Each mini-league has a group chat.

## Who it is for

Football fans who follow the Premier League and want a quick weekly prediction game to play against friends, family or colleagues, with bragging rights as the reward.

## What TOTL is not

- TOTL is not a gambling or sports betting product. Players do not place bets, stake money or win money on match results; predictions are scored with points only.
- TOTL is not a fantasy football game: there are no squads, line-ups or player transfers.
